Gene-level numbers: genes processed, the cancer-type-specific junction-group
search and its COSMIC enrichment, and the EZH2 / NF1 examples. Ported from
`tcga/gene_level_poisson/plotting_genes/gene_cancer_type_hits.Rmd`
(same aggregation, same tests). The last chunk prints text vs recomputed.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
if (!exists("QROOT")) QROOT <- local({ d <- normalizePath(getwd())   # quetzal_code root
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, ".quetzal_root"))) { if (dirname(d) == d) stop("run from inside quetzal_code/"); d <- dirname(d) }
  d })
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source(file.path(QROOT, "figures/scripts/paper_stats_common.R"))
```

## Aggregate per-gene results

Walks `chr*/{gene}/{junction_results,n_bb_tests}.tsv` and `res.RDS` under
`gene_level_poisson_root` (slow), cached in `cache/paper_stats_glp_<inputs>.rds`;
delete it to force a re-walk. `pre_rerun` swaps in the per-gene backups of the
2,114 genes rerun on 2026-10-06 (see `pre_rerun` note in the chunk).

```{r aggregate}
dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
CF   <- sprintf("cache/paper_stats_glp_%s.rds", ps_inputs())
ROOT <- file.path(QROOT, "quetzal_runs/gene_level")
# pre_rerun: the per-gene outputs as they were before the 2026-10-06 rerun =
# today's tree with the 2,114 rerun genes (chr10/11/18 + ANKIB1) swapped for
# their backups in pre_chr18fix_2026-10-06/ (every other gene is untouched).
BK <- file.path(ROOT, "pre_chr18fix_2026-10-06")
pick <- function(files) {
  rel <- substring(files, nchar(ROOT) + 2)
  bk  <- file.path(BK, rel)
  ifelse(file.exists(bk), bk, files)
}
if (file.exists(CF)) {
  agg <- readRDS(CF)
} else {
  jf <- Sys.glob(file.path(ROOT, "chr*", "*", "junction_results.tsv"))
  if (ps_inputs() == "pre_rerun") jf <- pick(jf)
  jf <- jf[file.size(jf) > 0]
  allj <- rbindlist(lapply(jf, function(f) tryCatch(fread(f), error = function(e) NULL)),
                    fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
  nb <- Sys.glob(file.path(ROOT, "chr*", "*", "n_bb_tests.tsv"))
  if (ps_inputs() == "pre_rerun") nb <- pick(nb)
  n_tests <- sum(vapply(nb, function(f) if (file.size(f) == 0) 0L else
    as.integer(fread(f, data.table = FALSE)$n_bb_tests[1]), integer(1)))
  rf <- Sys.glob(file.path(ROOT, "chr*", "*", "res.RDS"))
  allj[, bb_pvalue_bonf := pmin(bb_pvalue * n_tests, 1)]
  agg <- list(sig = as.data.frame(allj[bb_pvalue_bonf < 0.05 & bb_beta > 0]),
              n_tests = n_tests,
              processed = unique(basename(dirname(rf[file.size(rf) > 100]))))
  saveRDS(agg, CF)
}
cat("BB tests:", agg$n_tests, "| significant TCGA-up junction rows:", nrow(agg$sig), "\n")
```

## Genes processed, cancer-type-specific junction groups, COSMIC enrichment

```{r enrichment}
claim("GENE", "genes retained after filtering", "13,665", format(length(agg$processed), big.mark = ","))
sig_genes <- unique(na.omit(agg$sig$gene_name))
claim("GENE", "cancer-type-specific junction groups", "4,283",
      format(n_distinct(paste(agg$sig$gene_name, agg$sig$factor)), big.mark = ","))
claim("GENE", "  in genes", "3,366", format(length(sig_genes), big.mark = ","))

cos  <- fread(file.path(QROOT, "inputs/cosmic_tier_1.tsv"), data.table = FALSE)
enrich <- function(set) {
  in_set <- intersect(agg$processed, set)
  non    <- setdiff(agg$processed, cos$`Gene Symbol`)
  a <- length(intersect(sig_genes, in_set)); b <- length(in_set) - a
  c <- length(intersect(sig_genes, non));    d <- length(non) - c
  list(n = a, or = (a * d) / (b * c),
       p = chisq.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), 2, byrow = TRUE))$p.value)
}
e_all <- enrich(cos$`Gene Symbol`)
e_tsg <- enrich(cos$`Gene Symbol`[grepl("TSG", cos$`Role in Cancer`)])
claim("GENE", "COSMIC tier 1 genes among them", "181", e_all$n)
claim("GENE", "COSMIC enrichment (text: '1.7-fold', hypergeometric) odds ratio", "1.7",
      sprintf("%.1f", e_all$or))
claim("GENE", "COSMIC enrichment P (chi-squared)", "6.4e-08", fmt_p(e_all$p))
claim("GENE", "TSG-only: genes / odds ratio / chi-squared P (new)", "(not in text)",
      sprintf("%d / %.1f / %s", e_tsg$n, e_tsg$or, fmt_p(e_tsg$p)))
```

## EZH2 (Fig 1d) and NF1 (Fig 1e)

```{r examples}
ez <- readRDS(file.path(PS_FIG, "figure1/panel_d_e/output/EZH2_LAML/EZH2/gene_data.RDS"))
claim("GENE", "EZH2 k6 unique junctions", "5", length(ez$junctions_to_compare))
nf <- readRDS(file.path(PS_FIG, "figure1/panel_d_e/output/NF1_LUSC/NF1/gene_data.RDS"))
j  <- nf$junctions_to_compare[1]
fc <- mean(nf$tcga_norm_dat[, grep(j, colnames(nf$tcga_norm_dat))], na.rm = TRUE) /
      mean(nf$gtex_norm_dat[, grep(j, colnames(nf$gtex_norm_dat))], na.rm = TRUE)
claim("GENE", "NF1 LUSC vs GTEx lung inclusion fold (mean PSI)", "> 5-fold", sprintf("%.1f-fold", fc))
# Beta-binomial Wald P (aod::betabin; lib.R). aod computes 2*(1 - pnorm(|z|)),
# which rounds to 0 for |z| > ~8.3, so report it from the exact log10 P.
l10 <- nf$junction_log10p[[j]]; e10 <- floor(l10)
claim("GENE", "NF1 LUSC vs GTEx lung P (beta-binomial)", "2.1e-66",
      sprintf("%.1fe%d", 10^(l10 - e10), e10))
ezp <- ez$junction_log10p; ee <- floor(ezp)
cat("EZH2 k6 junction P (beta-binomial):", paste(sprintf("%.1fe%d", 10^(ezp - ee), ee), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```
